entries.value: A lone candle burns — yet the dust says no one has passed in years
Embers still glow in a fire pit; someone camped here recently
Torches sputter in wall sconces
A shuttered lantern hangs, its oil low
Pale phosphorescent fungus casts a dim glow
A faint magical light seeps from the very stones
A brazier of coals, tended by unseen hands
Daylight leaks through a crack far overhead
A single torch burns fresh in a bracket, its flame straight and steady
A ring of candles gutters low around something on the floor
Glowing mushrooms carpet the ceiling in cold blue light
A cracked lantern lies on its side, somehow still lit
A hovering orb of pale light drifts from room to room
Sunlight spears down through a rent in the ceiling far above
A crystal set in the wall glows with a steady inner light
Moonlight filters down a deep shaft, silvering the floor
A bonfire crackles at the room's centre, unattended
Green witch-light clings to the walls, cold and shadowless
A candelabra blazes with fresh candles, as if lit moments ago
Luminous moss traces the mortar between the stones
A lantern swings gently on its chain, throwing shadows that lurch
Veins of glowing mineral thread through the raw rock
A censer glows, spilling scented smoke and a dull red light
Foxfire clings to a heap of rotten timber, pale and flickering
A torch burns here with an unnatural violet flame
Slivers of daylight fall through arrow-slits high in the wall
A pool of glowing water lights the room from below
Rushlights smoulder in a rack along the wall
A brazier of green flame gives light but no warmth
Faint light bleeds from the cracks around a sealed door
A single lamp burns in a niche, its wick trimmed and clean
Glowing runes crawl slowly across the ceiling
A fire long dead, yet its coals still glow red — impossibly
A lantern hangs from a hook, its flame a steady, cold white
Sparks drift up through a floor grate lit by fire below
A cluster of fireflies pulses in the dark, impossibly, far underground
A dropped torch still burns where it fell, its owner gone
Sickly light pulses from a crack in the floor, in time with no heartbeat
